data.claim: Every caller reaches these modules through attribute or from-import access, which a package re-exporting each top-level name serves unchanged; the only callers a split breaks are 4 tests that monkeypatch a module-level name a moved function reads (K._load x2 in test_research_overwrite, K.BUG_REPORT_COMMAND in test_bug_scope, G.MAX_UNTRACKED_HASHED in test_gates) and 2 tests that read source by file path (test_auto_id_contract, test_coherence_coverage keys api/knowledge.py:<fn>). No module uses 'global', __module__ or getsource, so no other behaviour depends on the module a function lives in.
data.falsifier: Any other test or golden snapshot (every --help, MCP tools/list and prompts/list, config --explain, help) differs after the split once those 6 tests are re-pointed.
data.mechanism: A function resolves globals in its defining module; a package attribute rebinding does not reach a submodule's globals; path-based scans read file names.
data.probe: grep -rnE 'setattr\((G|K|A|R|RP|reporting|knowledge)\b|patch\(.ddflow\.(api\.(reporting|knowledge)|services\.gates)' tests; grep -rnE '(api/reporting|api/knowledge|services/gates)(\.py)?' tests; grep -nE '^\s*global |__module__|getsource' the three files
data.probe_output: patch sites: test_research_overwrite.py:127,173 setattr(K,'_load'); test_bug_scope.py:219 setattr(K,'BUG_REPORT_COMMAND'); test_gates.py:435 setattr(G,'MAX_UNTRACKED_HASHED'); (test_review_chunks G is api.gates, not services.gates). path reads: test_auto_id_contract.py:66 Path('ddflow/api/knowledge.py'); test_coherence_coverage.py:149-152,296 'api/knowledge.py:<fn>' keys. global/__module__/getsource in the three files: none.
data.question: Can api/reporting.py, services/gates.py and api/knowledge.py become packages that re-export every name without breaking any caller?
